after.text:
where MN (2k) is defined in (1.2). Observe that the inner summand is invariant as
m −→ N − n − m, and so the inner sum is in fact a sum of cosines (and thus the
series expansion in β contains only even powers of β). Furthermore observe that
both sides of the equation are analytic functions of k (for Re(k) ≥ 0), both sides
can be easily bounded bounded by O(22N Re(k) ) (for large k, with N and β fixed),
and the two sides are equal at the positive integers. Thus by Carlson’s theorem (see
§17 of [12], for example), the restriction on k being an integer is no longer required,

section_entries.label: 3.1. Number-theoretic comparisons
section_entries.mathematical_role: Compares the offset conjecture with a proved k=1 formula and a k=2 mollified theorem whose forbidden endpoint extrapolation reproduces the predicted profile and derivative moment.

unit_result_entry.title: The extrapolated k=2 profile reproduces the fourth derivative moment constant
unit_result_entry.why_material: Applying the same small-offset argument to the conditional k=2 profile yields the eighth-logarithmic-scale fourth moment of zeta prime and agrees with the earlier derivative conjecture.

unit_dependency_entry.context_note: This inherits both the impermissible eta=1 extrapolation and the offset-limit reasoning; it is not an unconditional theorem.
unit_dependency_entry.representation_dependency: The numerical constant and power are formula-sensitive and should be checked against the PDF.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: A mollified k=2 theorem matches the profile only after an unproved endpoint extrapolation
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: The available number-theoretic theorem controls a zeta value multiplied by a short Dirichlet polynomial for eta below one half; formally setting eta=1 turns the polynomial into zeta and the resulting series simplifies exactly to the predicted F_2 profile.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: The profile has a theorem-level comparison at k=1, whereas the k=2 agreement and derivative constant require pushing a mollifier-length parameter outside the proved range.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: The conditional k=2 match must not be reported as equivalent in evidential status to the RH-conditional k=1 theorem.
